description: HR-71 is the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office acting as a Registering and Licensing Authority for the Bilaspur sub-division in Yamunanagar district. It manages vehicle registration, driving licenses, and road tax collection for the local jurisdiction, often distinguished from Bilaspur in Gurugram.
address: SDM Office, Bilaspur, District Yamunanagar, Haryana
